verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for payment products, since self-hostable payment platforms exist. However, the evidence describes Mollie only as a hosted service: Mollie-hosted checkout pages and a hosted MCP endpoint that proxies the public API. Building your own checkout front-end on the Payments API is an integration option, not self-hosting of the core product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
